measurementNotes.turns: Turn bands are design windows, not guaranteed scene boundaries.
measurementNotes.counts: All content quantities are incremental within the band unless a field is explicitly named cumulative.
measurementNotes.uniqueDefinition: First exposure to an authored node or semantic family in the run.
measurementNotes.refreshedDefinition: Reuse with at least two material changes, including state, stakes, affordance, or consequence.
measurementNotes.staleDefinition: Reuse with no more than one cosmetic or non-material change.
measurementNotes.profileCaveat: Named profiles are mappings for commission-mentioned bibles; generic profiles are implementation patterns, not claims about additional canonical bibles.

profiles.releaseBlocker: Do not ship at the commission-reported zero-hub baseline.

bands.purpose: Create a durable build-and-world hook, establish the first social and progression institutions, apply natural combat pressure, and reach level 2 without padding.

durableOutcomes: dungeon objective and access path known

antiLoopChecks: No semantic mob family more than three times in a rolling 20 turns.
A defeated named enemy cannot respawn under the same entity and state IDs.
Travel acknowledgements cannot satisfy hub or encounter counts.
Registration exposition is once per fact state.
bands.exitCondition: Advance when level 2 is durable and the first dungeon objective is known; do not require dungeon entry before T30.

bands.purpose: Complete Arc I by widening the map, differentiating factions and encounter families, clearing the first dungeon, and reaching level 5.

durableOutcomes: reward changes build or faction state

antiLoopChecks: No two consecutive stale encounters.
Every unchanged hub revisit raises suppression weight.
A repeated NPC scene requires a new demand, fact, relationship, or quest state.
First-dungeon exit closes after terminal resolution.
bands.exitCondition: Advance only after level 5, first-dungeon terminal resolution, and at least one visible faction consequence; deadline is T100.

bands.purpose: Deliver Arc II through faction escalation, multiple dungeons, late-build expression, controlled reuse, and a terminal confrontation rather than indefinite grinding.
antiLoopChecks: No defeated boss re-entry without an authored transformation or resurrection contract.
At least 40% of content-bearing beats remain first-exposure and stale beats stay below 25%.
A mob family reused after cooldown must change objective plus tactics, stakes, or consequence.
Campaign resolution cannot route back to an unresolved travel pad.
bands.exitCondition: Terminate by T300 after a durable antagonist, faction, and world-state resolution; endless play requires a new versioned arc contract.

profiles.label: Generic Expedition

bands.purpose: Form the party, accept a quest, teach checks and positioning, and resolve the first dungeon wing or expedition obstacle without collapsing into generic combat.
antiLoopChecks: No identical skill-plus-DC-plus-consequence tuple within ten turns.
Resolved wing exits are terminal unless a new state explicitly reopens them.
At least one third of opening challenges must be non-combat.
A failed check changes cost, position, information, or relationship rather than repeating unchanged.
bands.exitCondition: Advance when the party has a shared quest state, one persistent relationship delta, and a terminal first-wing or route-obstacle resolution.

bands.purpose: Develop two to three dungeon wings or expedition zones, diversify traps and checks, stage a boss, and force a party or faction choice.

durableOutcomes: bond, rivalry, or departure risk changes

antiLoopChecks: Combat cannot exceed 60% of challenge scenes.
The same trap mechanism cannot recur without a changed detection and consequence pattern.
A boss terminal state closes its encounter contract.
Party beats require a relationship-state delta, not banter alone.
bands.exitCondition: Advance by T100 after resolving the mid-arc boss and a faction choice whose moral and route consequences are stored.

bands.purpose: Resolve the expedition through escalating zones, party consequences, multiple quest closures, and a final confrontation with morally differentiated outcomes.

durableOutcomes: earlier moral cost becomes mechanical or relational

requires: party fault line unresolved or transformed
durableOutcomes: bond, betrayal, sacrifice, or departure committed
final tactics and moral stakes known
party and quest consequences narrated from stored deltas

genreTelegraphs: explicit moral tradeoff at final objective
antiLoopChecks: No resolved wing, boss, or final confrontation can reopen without a versioned continuation arc.
At least four of every twelve challenge scenes are non-combat.
Reused rules grammar must change environment, stakes, and consequence.
Every major set piece advances at least two quest, party, or faction states.
bands.exitCondition: Terminate by T300 after the final confrontation and party-specific epilogues resolve all critical quest states.

profiles.label: Generic Faction Drama

bands.purpose: Open with a social crisis, establish leverage and factions, and force a first consequential alignment while making non-combat agency explicit.

durableOutcomes: social stakes and threatened institution known
usable fact, obligation, evidence, or relationship token stored
at least two incompatible demands visible
one future scene becomes harder, altered, or unavailable

antiLoopChecks: Each fact state can trigger its exposition bank once.
A repeated NPC scene requires a new demand, leverage topic, relationship delta, or office/role state.
No negotiation can return to the identical offer state after refusal.
The first alignment must alter availability or cost within ten turns.
bands.exitCondition: Advance after a stored leverage asset and a visible faction or relationship consequence establish the campaign's social direction.

bands.purpose: Escalate three to five social standoffs, moral dilemmas, betrayal consequences, and faction shifts until the player makes a major commitment.

durableOutcomes: venue, office, reputation, or faction access changes
one neutral actor commits or exits

antiLoopChecks: No unchanged venue revisit counts as a social hub beat.
Exposition retirement is keyed by fact state and audience.
Betrayal must change an NPC role and at least one quest or faction state.
At least half of major standoffs must support non-combat resolution.
bands.exitCondition: Advance by T100 when the major social commitment locks a climax route and has already produced a visible cost.

bands.purpose: Pay off alliances, betrayals, and moral debts through escalating social confrontations, a climax with non-combat routes, and differentiated consequence endings.

durableOutcomes: ally demand or collateral harm materializes
at least two NPC roles change
combat and non-combat routes resolved distinctly
NPC, faction, and player-status consequences persisted

antiLoopChecks: No leverage topic can be spent twice without a transformed fact state.
Recurring NPCs must change demand, status, relationship, or available resolution.
At least one ending dimension must derive from each of faction, relationship, and moral-choice ledgers.
The climax cannot reset to pre-confrontation negotiation state.
bands.exitCondition: Terminate by T300 with differentiated NPC and faction consequences; continuation requires a new crisis and cannot replay resolved leverage banks.

modeTargets.postEndingRequirement: Inert terminal state or explicit restart/new-campaign action through T300.

profiles.label: Thornferry

profiles.label: Vesper Glass

profiles.label: Generic Branching Crisis
profiles.emphasis: Fallback PYOA spine for other bibles

bands.purpose: Establish an opening crisis, exclusive facts, and a first fork whose costs and promised payoff are visible and cannot be erased by silent reconvergence.

durableOutcomes: failure clock or irreversible risk recorded
at least one fact withheld from alternate branch

antiLoopChecks: The opening crisis threat domain is unique within the run.
The first fork stores a branch-lock ID and cannot silently reconverge before payoff.
No return to the exact pre-choice state.
Exposition facts retire after delivery unless their truth state changes.
bands.exitCondition: Advance after the first fork produces an immediate durable aftershock and a delayed payoff due no later than sixty turns after the choice.

bands.purpose: Deliver two additional crises, deepen branches through exclusive facts, and manifest delayed payoffs while making ending locks increasingly legible.

durableOutcomes: at least one ending becomes eligible or impossible

antiLoopChecks: Major crises cannot share the same threat-domain ID.
A convergence may share a location but must preserve branch facts, relationships, costs, and available choices.
Every promised payoff has a due-turn and terminal outcome.
A named figure cannot repeat identical crisis exposition.
bands.exitCondition: Advance at T100 only if all due payoffs have manifested or have explicit later due turns and the ending-gate prerequisites are visible.

bands.purpose: Open the ending gate, resolve a final distinct crisis, and terminate the campaign with endings derived from preserved branch facts and costs.

durableOutcomes: last branch cost paid or transformed
all active crisis and choice contracts closed
no new story content without explicit restart

antiLoopChecks: No crisis, branch, or exposition beat may spawn after the ending ID is persisted.
Continue input returns terminal acknowledgement or offers explicit restart/new campaign only.
The ending cannot route to an earlier crisis node.
At least three ending patterns must differ by more than cosmetic prose.
bands.exitCondition: Persist a terminal ending by T150; from T151 through T300 the evaluator must observe inert acknowledgements or an explicit user-selected restart, otherwise the run fails.
